methods.label: Compare slopes
methods.explanation:
Points on the same nonvertical line have the same slope. Here the three horizontal coordinates are distinct, so the slope denominators are nonzero. The first two points give slope
\[
\frac{3-(-3)}{4-2}=3.
\]
The slope from \((4,3)\) to \((5,k/2)\) must also be \(3\), so
\[
\frac{k/2-3}{5-4}=3.
\]
Thus \(k/2=6\), giving the unique value \(\boxed{k=12}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
methods.levelReason: Comparing coordinate differences and solving a simple linear equation are sufficient.
